landing.heroTitle: Discover which occupations fit your skills
landing.heroSubtitle: Tell us about your background and skills in your own words. We'll show you the occupations your experience fits best — and the concrete skills to develop to get closer to your goal. A clear picture of your career path in minutes.
landing.feature1Body: You don't need to know thousands of skill terms. Tell us about your background and we'll do the mapping for you.
landing.feature2Body: Get a ranked list of occupations your skills fit best — and a percentage showing how close you are.
landing.feature3Body: Clearly see which skills you already have and which are worth learning next.
landing.trustNote: Built on the EU's official ESCO v1.2.1 occupations and skills classification.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take the next step?
landing.ctaBody: Create a free account and build your skill profile in minutes.
